v: Ha in Malaquías in tik, schekab' Dios waj t'a heb' wetisraelal.

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha in tik tzex in xajanej, palta a exxo tik, tzex tak'wi t'ayin icha tik: ¿Tas wal skutej kojtakaneli tato tzonh a xajanej? xe chi. Palta a in Jehová in swal t'ayex icha tik: Wach'chom yuk'tak sb'a winhaj Esaú yet' winhaj Jacob, palta te xajan wilnak winhaj Jacob chi', haton winh he mam eyicham,
haxo winhaj Esaú chi', maay. Ha lum tzalkixtak b'aj kajan heb' yinhtilal winhaj Esaú chi', kuseltakxonhej ix ajkan lum wuuj, haxonhej nok' kaltakte'al nok' ay ta'.

Q'uinalok a heb' edomita yinhtilalkan winhaj Esaú tz'alan icha tik: Wach'chom onh sateli, palta ol ko b'oxik'e ko chonhab' tik, ta xchi heb'. Wach'chom sb'oxik'e heb', palta a in ol in satxieli. Ol yal heb' anima t'a schonhab' heb' chi' icha tik: Ha jun nación tik, schonhab'il heb' chuk, aynhejkot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a yib'anh t'a masanil tiempo, xcham heb'.
Ha ex israel ex tik, ol eyil wal sik'lab'il, ol eyalan icha tik: Ha Jehová, yelxo wal te niwan yelk'och t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, manhoknhej t'a yol ko makb'en tik, xe chama, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan t'a heb' sacerdote icha tik: Ha heb' uninab'il, ay yelk'och smam snun heb' t'a sat. Ha heb' chekab', ay pax yelk'och spatrón heb' t'a sat. Yuj chi' ex sacerdote, tato mamab'il waj t'ayex eyalani, ¿tas pax yuj malaj welk'och t'ayex? Tato yajal waj t'ayex eyalani, ¿tas yuj max in he k'anab'ajej? Ha ex tik tzin he patikejeli, palta tzato wal eyal icha tik: ¿Tas skutej ach ko patikaneli? xe chi.
Tzeyik'kot he silab' manh smojok sjawi t'a waltar, tzato wal he k'anb'ani: ¿B'ajtil tz'och ko mul chi' t'ayach? xe chi. Tz'och he mul chi', yujto ichato malaj yelk'och waltar t'a he sat.

¿Tom wach' tze na'a to a nok' nok' ay spaltail tzeyak' t'ayin silab'il, haton nok' malaj yol sat, nok' q'uiich yet' nok' penaay? Q'uinalok tzeyik'b'at juntzanh nok' chi' he silab'ok t'a heb' eyajalil, ¿tom ol ex scha heb' yuj juntzanh he silab' chi' tze na'a?

Ha heb' anima tz'alan t'ayex icha tik: Ex sacerdote, k'anek t'a Dios kuuj, yik tz'ok' sk'ol t'ayonh, xchi heb'. Palta a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil swal icha tik: Tato a juntzanh nok' ix wal tik ol eyak' he silab'ok t'ayin, ¿tokwal ol in cha t'ayex t'a tzalajk'olal?

Komonok a junok ex tik tze mak spuertail in templo, yik wach' manh nab'anhejok skomon och k'ak' t'a waltar. Yujto a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, max in tzalaj jab'ok heyet'ok, manhxo ol in cha eyofrenda chi'.

Palta te niwan welk'och t'a sat masanil anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ha wal tas wach' snhustz'a heb' silab'il t'ayin. Syak'an yofrenda heb' t'ayin icha wal t'a smojalil, yujto niwan welk'och t'a yol sat heb'.
Palta a exxo tik, malaj jab'ok welk'och t'a yol he sat. Tzeyalani to malaj yelk'och waltar yet' juntzanh silab' tz'ak'ji t'ayin.

Tzeyalan icha tik: Tzonh tzaktzajk'och yet' juntzanh tik, xe chi. Tzin he patikaneli. Slajwi chi' tzeyak'an juntzanh nok' he silab' t'ayin, haton nok' tzeyelk'ej, nok' q'uiich yet' nok' penaay. ¿Tom ol in cha juntzanh chi' t'ayex tze na'a?

Ha in Rey in, niwan welk'ochi, xiw masanil chonhab' t'ayin, yuj chi' tzin katab'ej heb' stak'wej sti' yak'an junok skalnel malaj spaltail silab'il t'ayin, slajwi chi' sk'exan pax nok' heb', haxo junok nok' penaay syak' heb', xchi Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil.
Syalanpax Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil icha tik: Ha tiknaik ex sacerdote, a t'ayex swal juntzanh cheknab'il tik:

Yowalil ayokab' welk'och t'a yol he sat yet' eyopisio tik. Tato manh ol he k'anab'ajej, ol ex in katab'ej. Ayik ol eyalan wach' lolonel t'a yib'anh junok mach, haxo katab' ol wak'kan t'a yib'anh sk'exulok. Wal yel, a jun eyopisio chi', toxo ix in katab'ej, yujto max he k'anab'ajej in cheknab'il.

Eyuj a ex tik ex sacerdote, yuj chi' ol wak' q'uixwelal heb' eyinhtilal, a nok' tzeyik'kot silab'il chi' t'ayin, a stza' nok' ol in juloch t'a he sat. Junnhej ol aj ex in julanel yet' stza' nok' chi'.

Icha chi' ol aj snachajel eyuuj to a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil a in swak' jun cheknab'il tik, yik wach' a in trato wak'nakkan yet' heb' yinhtilal Leví, haton heb' he mam eyicham, ol b'eynhejb'atok.
Ha in trato yet' heb' chi' to swak' sk'inal heb' yet' sjunk'olal, yik ay welk'och t'a yol sat heb'. Ix sch'oxel heb' to ay welk'och t'a yol sat heb', ix in sk'anab'ajan heb'.
Yelnhej tas ix yal heb', malaj b'aj ix yesej heb'. Wach'nhej ix ek' heb' wet'ok. Jantak heb' ix yik'elta heb' t'a skal chukal.

Ha ex sacerdote ex tik, a eyopisio to tze k'ayb'ej heb' anima yik tzin yojtakejel heb'. Smoj sk'och masanil anima t'ayex, yik syab'an sk'ayb'ub'al heb', yujto a in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, in chekab' eyaji.
Ha exxo pax tik, toxo ix in he patikejeli. Yuj k'ayb'ub'al ix eyak'a', yuj chi' tzijtum heb' ix juwikaneli. Ha ex ix eyixtejb'at in trato wak'nak yet' winh he mam eyicham.

Max he k'anab'ajej tas tzin nib'ej, yujto manh lajanok tzeyutej he ch'olb'itan smasanil anima, yuj chi' swik'ek' sniwanil eyelk'ochi, emnakil tzex ajkan t'a sat masanil anima, xchi Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil.
Ha onh tik junnhej ko Mam, haton Dios b'ojinak onh ko masanil. ¿Tas yuj skak'laj musansatil ko b'a, skak'lan chukal t'ayonh junjun onh, skixtanb'at strato Dios yak'nak yet' heb' ko mam kicham?

Ha heb' wetchonhab' aj Judá, maj sk'anab'ajej heb' b'aj ix yak' sti' t'a yichanh Dios. Te chuklaj tas ix sk'ulej heb' t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a masanil yol smakb'en Israel. Ix yixtejb'at skajnub' Jehová heb', haton jun yiknhej yaji, xajan yuj. Ha heb' winh winak, ix yik'laj sb'a heb' winh yet' heb' ix ix ch'ok chonhab'il tz'och ejmelal t'a komon Dios.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, komonok tz'el t'a sk'ol satanel masanil heb' sk'ulan juntzanh chi' t'a ko kal a onh yinhtilal onh winhaj Jacob tik, yalxonhej mach, wach'chom syik'paxkot silab' heb' t'ay.
Ay wal junxo tas tze k'ulej: Toxonhej sch'ayxiel yaltar Jehová yuj yal he sat eyoq'ui. Tzex ok' wal sik'lab'il, yujto maxtzak chaji eyofrenda yuj Jehová.

Tzato he k'anb'an t'a Jehová chi' icha tik: ¿Tas yuj maxtzak a cha kofrenda chi'? xe chi. Haton yuj tik: Yujto a wal Jehová ix hilani to max he k'anab'ajej he ti' eyak'nak t'a heb' ix ix eyik'nak he b'a yet'ok t'a he kelemal, wach'chom a heb' ix chi' eyetb'eyum heb' ix b'aj eyak'nak he ti' chi' eyik'lan he b'a yet'ok.

¿Tom manh junnhejok b'ob'il onh yuj Dios yik junnhej niwanil tzonh aj yet' heb' ix? ¿Tas nab'il yuj Dios, yuj chi' icha chi' ix onh yutej tze na'a? Icha chi' ix onh yutej, yik wach' a heb' kuninal ay yelk'och Dios t'a yol sat heb'. Yuj chi' tzeyil wal he b'a yet' he pensar yik manh chukok tzeyutej he b'a t'a heb' ix eyetb'eyum b'aj ix eyak' he ti' eyik'lan he b'a yet'ok t'a he kelemal.

Ha wal Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, haton Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Tzeyil wal he b'a, aq'ek elk'och he ti' eyak'nak t'a ix eyetb'eyum. Yujto a jun pojlajb'ail chi', te chuk t'a yol in sat, yuj chi' manh he jub'at he b'a yuj jun chi', xchi Jehová.

Toxo ix tzaktzajk'e Jehová yuj tas tzeyala', tzato wal he k'anb'an icha tik: ¿Tas ix kala' yuj chi' stzaktzajk'e Jehová chi' ket'ok? xe chi. Stzaktzaj heyet'ok, yujto tzeyala' to a Jehová scha sk'ol heb' sk'ulan chukal, stzalaj yet' heb' eyalani. Tzeyalanpaxi to malaj junok Dios sch'olb'itan t'a stojolal.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ol in chekb'at jun in chekab', yik b'at sb'o in b'e a in Yajal in tik tanhwab'il in eyuuj. Elanhchamel ol in och t'a yol in templo. Tze nib'ej sk'och lemnaj in chekab' chi', yik syak'an elk'och in trato. Ab'ek, a in ton wal ol in k'ochok.

Palta, ¿mach ol techaj yuj t'a jun k'u ayik ol in k'och chi'? ¿Mach wal ol stek'b'ej sb'a t'a wichanh? Yujto a wopisio, lajan wal icha schakil te' k'ak' sk'an heb' b'oum k'een, ma icha nok' xapon sk'an heb' sjuk'wi.

Ha in Jehová in tik ol in em k'ojan, yik tzin sakb'itan heb' yinhtilal Leví, icha wal tz'aj yik'jiel smikal k'een plata, ma k'een oro t'a skal k'ak'. Ichato chi', ol yak'an yofrenda heb' t'a wichanh, icha t'a smojal yet' t'a stojolal.
Ha in Jehová in tik, ol in tzalaj yet' yofrenda heb' aj Jerusalén yet' heb' ay t'a juntzanhxo lugar t'a yol smakb'en Judá, icha ajnak in tzalaj yet'ok t'a pekataxo.

Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil swal icha tik: Ol in k'och t'a he kal yik tzex in ch'olb'itej. Elanhchamel ol wak'och t'a yib'anh juntzanh heb' tik: Haton heb' ajb'aal, heb' sk'ulan ajmulal, heb' esalwum, heb' manh tz'akanok stupan smunlajwum, heb' tz'ixtan heb' ix chamnak yetb'eyum yet' heb' unin chamnak smam yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il. Ol wak'paxoch t'a yib'anh heb' malaj welk'och t'ay.
Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil, malaj b'ak'uinh tzin k'exmaji. Yuj chi', a ex yinhtilal ex Jacob tik, maj ex satel-laj

wach'chom ix he patikejel in cheknab'il, maj he k'anab'ajejlaj, lajan ix eyutej he b'a icha yutejnak sb'a heb' he mam eyicham. Ha tiknaik, meltzajanhekxi t'ayin, yik ol in meltzajxib'at k'elan t'ayex. Palta he ex tik tze k'anb'ej: ¿Tas tz'aj ko meltzajxi t'ayach? xe chi.

Ha in xo tik tzin k'anb'ej t'ayex: ¿Tom smoj tz'elk'an heb' anima t'a sDiosal? Palta a ex tik tzin eyelk'ej. Tzato he k'anb'an icha tik: ¿Tas b'aj tzach kelk'ej chi'? xe chi. Ha b'aj tzin eyelk'ej, haton t'a masanil he diezmo yet' eyofrenda.
Yuj chi' t'a wal yel katab'il exxo he masanil, yujto he masanil tzin eyelk'ej.

Ha tiknaik jun, ik'ekkot masanil he diezmo b'aj smolchaj t'a in templo, yik wach' ay tas swa heb' tzin ak'an serwil ta'. Ha in Jehová Yajal in t'a Smasanil swal icha tik: To tzin eyak' prowal. Icha wal chi' ol aj heyilani to ol in jak satcha'anh, ol in sekanemta in wach'k'olal t'a eyib'anh, manhxalaj b'aj ol aj yet'tal eyuuj.
Ha in swala' to manh ol in cha lajwokel tas awab'il eyuuj yuj nok' nok', manh ol in chapax ixtaxel sat eyuwa ayik manto q'uinhb'i.
Ol yal juntzanhxo chonhab' eyuuj to te wach' eyiko' yujto te wach' ol elk'och he chonhab' tik, xchi Jehová.
Syalanpax Jehová icha tik: Ha ex tik, te chuk tzeyal t'ayin. Tzato wal he k'anb'an icha tik: ¿Tas chuk skal t'ayach? xe chi.

Icha tik tzeyutej eyalani: Nab'anhej skak' serwil Dios. Malaj skak' yala' tato sko k'anab'ajej tas syala', skak'anoch pichul yik kusk'olal t'a yichanh Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, yik sko ch'oxan ko kusk'olal yuj ko mul.
Skil wal heb' syik'chaanh sb'a, tzalajk'olal yaj heb'. Yet' heb' chuk, wach'nhej tz'elk'och heb'. Ha heb' stek'b'ej sb'a t'a yichanh Dios, malaj pax yaelal sja t'a yib'anh heb', xe chi, xchi Jehová.

Ha heb' ay yelk'och Jehová t'a yol sat, slolon heb' t'ay junjun, haxo Jehová chi' tz'ab'an tas syal heb' chi'. Yuj chi' schekji tz'ib'chajkan sb'i heb' t'a jun libro, haton ta' sb'inajkan heb' ay yelk'och Jehová t'a yol sat, yujto ay wal och spensar heb' t'ay.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ay jun k'ual ol in ch'olb'itej masanil heb' anima. Ha heb' ay welk'och t'ay, ol in sik'kanel heb' yik tz'ochkan heb' wikok. Icha junok mamab'il tz'ok' sk'ool t'a junok yuninal tz'ak'an serwil, icha chi' ol aj yok' in k'ool t'a heb'.
Hata' ol nachajel eyuuj to ch'ok spak yik heb' wach' sb'eyb'al tzin ak'an serwil, ch'ok pax spak yik heb' chuk sb'eyb'al max in ak'anlaj serwil, xchi Jehová.

Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ab'ek, wan sja sk'ual yik ol in ch'oxan yowal in k'ool. Ol in satel masanil heb' b'uchumtak yet' heb' sk'ulan chukal icha wal tz'aj stz'ab'at anh ak t'a yol junok horno. Manhxa junok heb' ol kanok.

Palta a ex to ay welk'och t'a he sat, icha wal sk'eul k'u t'a q'uinhib'alil, icha chi' ol wutej in ch'oxan in kolwal t'ayex. Yuj chi', ol ex tzalajxok. Ol ex k'e cheneljok yuj tzalajk'olal, icha tz'aj sk'e cheneljok nok' kelemtak wakax tz'elta b'aj makan.
Ha t'a jun k'ual chi', a ex tik toxonhej ol he tek'kanem heb' sk'ulan chukal, icha wal tz'aj stek'jiem k'een tik'aq'uil taanh, icha chi' ol eyutej heb'.

Naekkot in cheknab'il wak'nakkan t'a winh in chekab' aj Moisés, ayik ayek' winh t'a sjolom lum witz skuch Horeb. Ha juntzanh k'ayb'ub'al yet' cheknab'il chi', smoj wal to tze k'anab'ajej he masanil a ex israel ex tik.
Ab'ek, ol in b'ab'laj chekejb'at winh in chekab' aj Elías, ayik manto jawi jun k'ual yik ol cheklaj yowal in k'ool. Ha jun k'ual chi', te niwan yelk'ochi, ayxo smay ol ujok.
Ha winhaj Elías chi' ol ak'anoch heb' mamab'il yet' heb' uninab'il t'a junk'olal. Tato manh ol sna sb'a heb', haxo yik ol in k'ochok, haxo in satanel he chonhab' chi' t'a junelnhej, xchi Jehová.
